profile.summary: Living Jazz is an Oakland-based nonprofit that provides jazz-rooted music education and performance programs. It runs in-school programs for East Bay elementary schools, summer music camps, and community events such as an annual MLK tribute concert.

review.notes: Living Jazz is an Oakland 501(c)(3) (EIN 94-2963195 on both ProPublica and its own About page), and its RootED music and dance program in East Bay elementary schools fits OUSD's school and after-school contracts.
